prompt: Write a Microsoft Sentinel scheduled analytics rule, as a YAML file rule.yaml in the Azure-Sentinel repository format with the KQL inline, that detects password spray against Entra ID from a single source IP using SigninLogs. It should run every hour. Make it something I could deploy without surprises.
assertions: rule.yaml has queryPeriod strictly longer than queryFrequency (no zero-overlap 1h/1h window) or the query selects the run window on ingestion_time()
The query handles ingestion delay explicitly: it uses ingestion_time() or declares a delay/wait window (e.g. let query_wait / ingestion_delay) that is added to the scan window

Result codes are declared in let lists (not scattered inline) and the logic distinguishes MFA/Conditional-Access interrupt codes (e.g. 50074, 50076, 53003, 50158) as credential-valid from true credential failures (50126, 50053)
The query aggregates by source IPAddress with a distinct count of user principals (dcount) and the threshold(s) are declared in let statements
entityMappings contains an IP entity whose columnName appears, with identical casing, in the final projection of the query
Every make_set / make_list call in the query includes a size cap argument
tactics includes CredentialAccess and relevantTechniques includes T1110.003
rule.yaml includes incident grouping or suppression settings (incidentConfiguration.groupingConfiguration or suppressionDuration) or alert enrichment (customDetails / alertDetailsOverride)
The query selects the hourly run window on ingestion_time() (the documented no-gap/no-duplicate form), not merely a declared delay variable used as a recency guard
